reviews: Security and privacy review of cache contents and redaction guarantees
Validation correctness review of dependency coverage, invalidation, and fail-toward-run behavior

findings.summary: Cache entries contain only: validator name (string), pass/fail (boolean), error count (integer), SHA-256 hex key (64-char hex string), and ISO timestamps. buildEntry() (validation-cache.cjs:298-309) and buildSuiteEntry() (318-333) produce no file contents, error messages, provider prompts/responses, or credentials. validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs (lines 150-170) scans for JWT, API key, and credential patterns in the entry structure and confirms none present.

The .projectops/validation-cache/ directory is not in .gitignore. Resolved in code: gitState() (validation-cache.cjs:191-216) filters the cache directory from git status porcelain output so cache writes do not make the tree appear dirty. walkDir() (line 83) skips 'validation-cache' so hashing .projectops as a declared input does not include cache contents. A .gitignore entry is cosmetically desirable but not mechanically required for correctness or security.

No network call, no data exfiltration path. walkDir() (validation-cache.cjs:75-88) excludes node_modules, .git, target, and validation-cache. hashFile() uses only readFileSync and crypto.createHash — purely local I/O. writeEntry() (line 271-279) catches all errors silently; a write failure is a performance loss, never a security or correctness loss.

All fail-toward-run paths verified by static trace: empty inputPaths → coverage 'none' (line 141-143); missing/unreadable input → coverage 'partial' (lines 155-159); checkValidatorCache rejects non-full coverage (line 391, returns null); readEntry rejects non-JSON (returns null), wrong schemaVersion (line 249, returns null), expired entries (age > MAX_ENTRY_AGE_MS, lines 399-400 and 350-351, returns null), NaN age (returns null). No code path produces a cache hit when inputs are unknown, changed, corrupt, or expired.

Full uncached validation (validate-all.cjs) is unmodified and remains authoritative. The cached runner is an explicitly documented ALTERNATIVE (cached-runner.cjs header lines 7-8), not a replacement. Module list identity between validate-all.cjs and cached-runner.cjs is enforced mechanically by validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs (lines 30-72), which extracts and compares both MODULES arrays element-by-element.

Cache deletion safety: clear() (validation-cache.cjs:487-495) uses fs.rmSync with recursive+force. After deletion, readEntry() returns null for absent files, checkValidatorCache and checkSuiteCache return null (miss), causing the validator to run. No correctness property anywhere in the codebase depends on cache presence.

readEntry() (validation-cache.cjs:244-265) correctly branches on entry.kind === 'suite' to validate suite-specific fields (head, results[]) versus per-validator fields (passed, errorCount). Without this branch, the suite fast path — the primary <=2s target — would always miss because readEntry would reject every suite entry as corrupt. Confirmed resolved in current source.

walkDir() skips 'validation-cache' (validation-cache.cjs:83), preventing cascading invalidation when plan validators declare .projectops as an input. Without this, writing a cache entry would change the .projectops hash, invalidating all plan validators' cache keys — a self-defeating cycle. gitState() independently filters cache directory lines from porcelain output (lines 203-208). Both defences confirmed present in current source.

Suite-level fast path (checkSuiteCache, validation-cache.cjs:340-363) requires two bound-git calls (rev-parse HEAD, status --porcelain) plus one JSON file read and one SHA-256 key comparison — all local, sub-second operations. Per-validator cache (checkValidatorCache, lines 389-406) avoids running unchanged validators when declared inputs match. The warm unchanged target (<=2s) is achievable by the suite fast path by construction. The targeted source target (<=60s) is achievable by the per-validator cache when only a subset of inputs changed.

Input map declarations for broad-scan validators (e.g. validate-no-secrets covering all of projectos/ and knowledge/) have coarse granularity: any file change under those trees invalidates the per-validator cache. This is correct (conservative — no false hits) but limits cache effectiveness for partial changes to those trees. The suite fast path covers the warm-unchanged case regardless.

Mechanical benchmark execution was blocked by the permission system across three consecutive invocations at HEAD 204fda72feca (sessions 1d841ce3, 121e575a, 1b2c28a4). validate-no-secrets passed (exit 0) and all test suites passed (682+all core, all agent, typecheck clean) in prior evidence at the same HEAD (session 121e575a). The cache correctness validator (validate-speed-validation-cache.cjs) was verified by complete static trace through all 8 test sections. A permission-unblocked run is recommended for mechanical benchmark proof.
